newsitem.title: UK: N.Electric to write shareholders this week.
newsitem.headline: N.Electric to write shareholders this week.

text.p: Northern Electric said on Monday it would write to its shareholders this week stating reasons as to why they should reject the revised buyout offer by CE Electric.
CE Electric, majority owned by U.S. utility group CalEnergy Co Inc, had said on Monday it had secured about 33.27 percent of ordinary shares in its bid target by the end of last week.
CE Electric said it had received valid accptances for 4.3 million shares while it had purchased about 29.5 million shares from the market under its hostile bid.
Northern said it had noted that the number of valid acceptances amounted to only 4.2 percent of its share capital.
"We are encouraged by the continuing support of our shareholders to whom we will be writing this week setting out why we believe CE Electric's revised offer should be rejected," the UK company said.
CE had raised its bid for Northern Electric on Friday by 20 pence per share to 650p, but the UK utility rejected the offer, arguing it undervalued the company.
